messages.subject: [Deployment issue]
parts:
Hi there,

I am failing to deploy my first app for the Coursera Data Products course with Johns Hopkins.
The app works without issues locally.

Here's what I am using:
Mac OSX version 10.9
Processor 1.8 GHz Intel Core i5
Memory 4GB 1600 MHz DDR3

R version 3.1.3 (2015-03-09)


Here's what I am putting in the terminal:

library(shinyapps)

shinyapps::deployApp('~Desktop/DOCDOC') 


Here's what I get from the Terminal:

shinyapps::deployApp("~/Desktop/DOCDOC")

Preparing to deploy application...DONE

Uploading bundle for application: 64146...DONE

Deploying bundle: 287360 for application: 64146 ...

Waiting for task: 91173516

  building: Processing bundle: 287360

  building: Parsing manifest

Error in function (type, msg, asError = TRUE)  : 

  Could not resolve host: api.shinyapps.io

Timing stopped at: 0.01 0.003 0.014 


Any idea how to resolve?


Thanks,


stephane

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] [Deployment issue]
parts:
It looks like you might be having trouble with your internet connection. 

I would check your connection and try again.

-Andy

messages.subject: Re: [Deployment issue]
parts:
Problem solved:
1. wifi connectivity solved through thunderbolt to ethernet cable
2. hugeness of the data being transferred solved by downsizing

Thanks!

S
